// waf-malformed: generated by the access-gateway console from WAF group malformed; do not edit.
// rules=2 group-mode=log explicit-modes block=0/log=0/off=0

// malformed-control-chars (priority 500, block): URI 控制字符
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "malformed-control-chars");
}

// malformed-triple-encoding (priority 510, log): 三重百分号编码探测
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "%[0-9a-f]{2}%[0-9a-f]{2}%[0-9a-f]{2}"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "malformed-triple-encoding");
}

return true;
